Parking fees vary depending on the type of vehicle: cars are $10 per vehicle, motorcycles are $5, and campers are $20 per space per day, with an additional $10 fee for extended awnings or cars occupying adjacent spaces. In addition to the on-site parking, private parking lots are available in the neighborhoods along Memorial Avenue. These lots are not affiliated with The Big E, and the fees are set by the property owners, so prices may vary.
